verses.text: A Song of Ascents. How blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, Who walks in His ways.
verses.textZh: （上行之詩。）凡敬畏耶和華、遵行他道的人便為有福！

verses.text: When you shall eat of the fruit of your hands, You will be happy and it will be well with you.
verses.textZh: 你要吃勞碌得來的；你要享福，事情順利。

verses.text: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine Within your house, Your children like olive plants Around your table.
verses.textZh: 你妻子在你的內室，好像多結果子的葡萄樹；你兒女圍繞你的桌子，好像橄欖栽子。

verses.text: Behold, for thus shall the man be blessed Who fears the LORD.
verses.textZh: 看哪，敬畏耶和華的人必要這樣蒙福！

verses.text: The LORD bless you from Zion, And may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
verses.textZh: 願耶和華從錫安賜福給你！願你一生一世看見耶路撒冷的好處！

verses.text: Indeed, may you see your children's children. Peace be upon Israel!
verses.textZh: 願你看見你兒女的兒女！願平安歸於以色列！
